name: kf_end_main
summary: END.EXE top-level entry loop initializing systems and playing ending STR movies.

name: kf_end_init_graphics
summary: Initializes PS1-SDK GPU/GTE with white clear color and 320x240 double-buffered display/draw environments.

name: kf_end_init_sound
summary: Initializes libsnd audio and sets master and CD serial audio volume for ending playback.

name: kf_end_begin_frame
summary: Swaps active ending display buffer, clears 1024-entry ordering table, and resets packet cursor.

name: kf_end_end_frame
summary: Waits for DrawSync/VSync, swaps active DRAWENV/DISPENV pair, and submits ending ordering table.

name: kf_end_pre_init_noop
summary: Empty pre-initialization stub called at startup of kf_end_main.

name: kf_end_entry_point
summary: C runtime entry point (start) dispatching directly into kf_end_main.

name: kf_end_play_ending_movie
summary: Opens \OP\ED0.S;1 or \OP\ED1.S;1 on CD-ROM and decodes/displays ending STR movie frames.

name: kf_end_init_str_decoder_state
summary: Initializes double-buffered MDEC/VLC buffers and 320x240 video upload RECT geometry.

name: kf_end_start_str_stream
summary: Resets MDEC hardware, attaches DMA output callback, configures StSetRing/Stream, and starts CdRead2.

name: kf_end_mdec_out_callback
summary: MDEC DMA completion ISR uploading decoded vertical video strip to VRAM and advancing next slice.

name: kf_end_decode_next_str_frame
summary: Polls next complete ending STR frame from CD ring, decodes DCT macroblocks, and frees ring.

name: kf_end_wait_str_ring_frame
summary: Polls StGetNext up to 0x800000 tries, validates frame size, and flags playback end at frame ceiling.

name: kf_end_wait_str_vram_upload
summary: Waits for kf_end_mdec_out_callback VRAM slice upload completion flag with bounded timeout.

name: kf_end_seek_and_play_cd_stream
summary: Issues CdlSeekL command and starts double-speed real-time CD streaming via CdRead2.

name: kf_end_sbrk3
summary: Extends or allocates raw bytes from the SN heap3 arena top pointer within configured heap bounds.

name: kf_end_realloc3_try_resize
summary: Attempts in-place growth/shrink or coalescing resize of an allocated SN malloc3 heap block.

name: kf_end_init_heap3
summary: Initializes SN malloc3 heap arena start, limit, and remaining free size globals.

name: kf_end_malloc3
summary: Allocates word-aligned memory block from SN malloc3 free list, extending arena with sbrk3 if needed.

name: kf_end_free3
summary: No-op SN heap3 release stub retained by PS1-SDK malloc3 linkage in END.EXE.

name: kf_end_realloc3
summary: Reallocates SN malloc3 block in-place when possible or copies contents into newly allocated block.

name: kf_end_calloc3
summary: Allocates zero-initialized array from SN malloc3 heap and clears bytes with bzero.

name: kf_end_exit_critical_section
summary: Invokes PS1 BIOS ExitCriticalSection syscall(0) wrapper to re-enable interrupts.

name: kf_end_dec_dct_reset
summary: Resets MDEC hardware state and callbacks via ResetCallback and low-level MDEC reset.

name: kf_end_dec_dct_vlc
summary: Decodes PlayStation STR bitstream into MDEC run-level data, dispatching v1/v2 or v3 Huffman decoder.

name: kf_end_dec_dct_in
summary: Patches MDEC command header RGB24/STP mode bits and initiates MDEC input DMA transfer.

name: kf_end_dec_dct_out
summary: Starts MDEC output DMA transfer of decoded pixel slices into specified RAM buffer.

name: kf_end_dec_dct_in_sync
summary: Waits for pending MDEC input DMA transfer completion with hardware timeout check.

name: kf_end_dec_dct_out_sync
summary: Waits for pending MDEC output DMA transfer completion with hardware timeout check.

name: kf_end_mdec_reset_hw
summary: Clears MDEC in/out DMA channels and uploads hardware quantization/IDCT tables when mode is zero.

name: kf_end_mdec_dma_in
summary: Waits for prior MDEC input DMA and launches CH0 DMA transfer feeding MDEC command and macroblocks.

name: kf_end_mdec_dma_out
summary: Waits for prior MDEC output DMA and launches CH1 DMA transfer draining decoded pixels.

name: kf_end_mdec_in_sync
summary: Polls DMA CH0 enable bit until MDEC input completes or invokes timeout diagnostics.

name: kf_end_mdec_out_sync
summary: Polls DMA CH1 enable bit until MDEC output completes or invokes timeout diagnostics.

name: kf_end_mdec_print_status
summary: Prints MDEC DMA channel activity, addresses, FIFO flags, and pixel format status over stdout.

name: kf_end_mdec_timeout_handler
summary: Logs MDEC timeout diagnostic message, dumps hardware status, and performs warm MDEC reset.

name: kf_end_mdec_vlc_decode_v1_v2
summary: Decodes STR version 1 and 2 bitstream Huffman AC/DC coefficients into MDEC input buffer.

name: kf_end_mdec_vlc_decode_v3
summary: Decodes STR version 3 Huffman-compressed bitstream coefficients into MDEC input buffer.

name: kf_end_mdec_vlc_decode_dc_coeff
summary: Reads variable-length Huffman DC coefficient word using MDEC v3 lookup tables.

name: kf_end_gpu_write_gp1_cmd
summary: Masks 24-bit GPU status control command and dispatches via low-level GPU_cw BIOS call.

name: kf_end_reset_graph
summary: Resets GPU command queue and hardware registers, hooking GPU IRQ callback according to reset mode.

name: kf_end_set_graph_reverse
summary: Sets GPU display horizontal-reverse mode flag and updates GP1 display parameters.

name: kf_end_set_graph_debug
summary: Configures libgpu debug verbosity level and prints current graph type/reverse state when non-zero.

name: kf_end_get_graph_type
summary: Returns detected PlayStation GPU revision type flag from libgpu state.

name: kf_end_set_disp_mask
summary: Enables or blanks PlayStation video display output via GP1(03h) command.

name: kf_end_draw_sync
summary: Synchronizes GPU command queue and DMA completion, returning remaining queue depth or completion.

name: kf_end_clear_image
summary: Enqueues asynchronous VRAM rectangle fill command using specified 24-bit RGB color.

name: kf_end_load_image
summary: Enqueues asynchronous CPU-to-VRAM pixel DMA upload for specified VRAM rectangle.

name: kf_end_store_image
summary: Enqueues asynchronous VRAM-to-CPU pixel DMA readback for specified VRAM rectangle.

name: kf_end_move_image
summary: Constructs GP0(80h) VRAM-to-VRAM copy primitive and submits it to GPU command queue.

name: kf_end_clear_otag
summary: Initializes forward-linked ordering table array with end-of-table terminator.

name: kf_end_clear_otag_r
summary: Dispatches reverse ordering table clear through GPU hardware vtable slot +0x2c.

name: kf_end_draw_prim
summary: Validates primitive when debug enabled, waits for GPU idle, and writes packet words via PIO.

name: kf_end_draw_otag
summary: Enqueues ordering table DMA chain for GPU execution or falls back to CPU trace in debug level 2.

name: kf_end_put_draw_env
summary: Builds GP0 draw-environment packet inside DRAWENV, submits it to GPU queue, and caches active state.

name: kf_end_put_disp_env
summary: Applies DISPENV display area, screen range, interlace, and 24-bit flags to GPU GP1 registers.

name: kf_end_set_draw_tex_window
summary: Packs GP0(E2h) texture window masking command from rectangle struct into draw mode buffer.

name: kf_end_set_draw_area
summary: Packs GP0(E3h/E4h) drawing clip rectangle top-left and bottom-right GPU commands.

name: kf_end_set_draw_offset
summary: Packs GP0(E5h) 2D drawing X/Y origin offset GPU command.

name: kf_end_set_draw_mode
summary: Packs GP0(E1h) draw mode and GP0(E2h) texture window commands into DR_MODE packet.

name: kf_end_build_draw_env_packets
summary: Compiles DRAWENV clip, offset, texture page, texture window, and clear fill into GPU DMA packet.

name: kf_end_pack_gpu_draw_mode_cmd
summary: Encodes GP0(E1h) draw-mode control word with dither, display-area draw, and GPU-version tpage bits.

name: kf_end_pack_gpu_clip_tl_cmd
summary: Clamps coordinates to VRAM bounds and encodes GP0(E3h) drawing area top-left command.

name: kf_end_pack_gpu_clip_br_cmd
summary: Clamps coordinates to VRAM bounds and encodes GP0(E4h) drawing area bottom-right command.

name: kf_end_pack_gpu_offset_cmd
summary: Encodes signed X/Y screen drawing offset into GP0(E5h) GPU command word.

name: kf_end_pack_gpu_tex_window_cmd
summary: Encodes 8-pixel-step texture window mask and offset fields into GP0(E2h) GPU command.

name: kf_end_calc_disp_vram_x
summary: Computes VRAM display start X coordinate accounting for GPU type and horizontal reverse flag.

name: kf_end_dma_clear_otag
summary: Launches PlayStation DMA Channel 6 (OTC) reverse linked-list clear with timeout check.

name: kf_end_cb_clear_image_vram
summary: GPU queue callback submitting GP0(02h) fast VRAM rectangle fill or clipped fallback quad.

name: kf_end_cb_load_image_vram
summary: GPU queue callback initiating DMA Channel 2 upload of rectangular texture pixels into VRAM.

name: kf_end_cb_store_image_vram
summary: GPU queue callback initiating DMA Channel 2 readback of rectangular VRAM pixels into RAM.

name: kf_end_gpu_write_gp1_cached
summary: Writes GP1 control command register to GPU hardware.

name: kf_end_gpu_read_gp1_cached
summary: Reads cached GPU display configuration shadow word tagged with register index.

name: kf_end_gpu_pio_write_prim_words
summary: Switches GPU to CPU-in mode (GP1 04h) and streams primitive words directly to GP0 FIFO.

name: kf_end_gpu_dma_send_otag
summary: Switches GPU to DMA-out mode and starts DMA Channel 2 linked-list transfer of ordering table.

name: kf_end_gpu_read_gp0_info
summary: Queries GP1(10h) GPU internal information register and returns masked 24-bit result.

name: kf_end_gpu_queue_add_prim
summary: Enqueues zero-copy GPU command entry with no inline payload copy.

name: kf_end_gpu_queue_enqueue
summary: Inserts command entry into 64-slot GPU ring queue, flushing head when queue is nearly full.

name: kf_end_gpu_queue_flush_next
summary: GPU IRQ callback draining ready ring-queue items and executing next queued DMA/VRAM operation.

name: kf_end_gpu_reset_hw_and_queue
summary: Clears 64-slot GPU command queue and issues hardware/DMA reset sequence on GPU.

name: kf_end_gpu_draw_sync
summary: Polls until GPU command ring, DMA CH2, and GPU busy flags all drain or return non-blocking depth.

name: kf_end_gpu_reset_timeout
summary: Sets GPU watchdog deadline to current VSync counter plus 240 frames.

name: kf_end_gpu_check_timeout
summary: Checks GPU watchdog deadline; prints queue/DMA state and resets GPU hardware on timeout.

name: kf_end_gpu_memcpy_bytes
summary: Local byte-copy helper compiled inside libgpu queue object.

name: kf_end_gpu_memset_bytes
summary: Local byte-fill helper compiled inside libgpu queue object.

name: kf_end_load_tpage
summary: Uploads texture image to VRAM according to pixel bit-depth and returns encoded tpage ID.

name: kf_end_load_clut
summary: Uploads 256-entry CLUT row to VRAM at (x, y) and returns encoded 16-bit CLUT handle.

name: kf_end_set_def_draw_env
summary: Populates DRAWENV structure defaults for target VRAM framebuffer region.

name: kf_end_set_def_disp_env
summary: Populates DISPENV structure defaults for target VRAM scanout region.

name: kf_end_get_tpage
summary: Encodes texture bit-depth, semi-transparency mode, and VRAM page X/Y into 16-bit tpage ID.

name: kf_end_get_clut
summary: Encodes VRAM palette X/Y coordinates into 16-bit GPU CLUT attribute word.

name: kf_end_dump_tpage
summary: Prints decoded texture page bit-depth, blend mode, and VRAM coordinates via printf.

name: kf_end_dump_clut
summary: Prints decoded CLUT VRAM X/Y coordinates via printf.

name: kf_end_dump_draw_env
summary: Prints DRAWENV clip, offset, texture window, dither/draw flags, and tpage settings.

name: kf_end_dump_disp_env
summary: Prints DISPENV VRAM source rect, CRT screen rect, interlace, and RGB24 flags.

name: kf_end_get_prim_type_name
summary: Looks up human-readable GPU primitive mnemonic string from command opcode byte.

name: kf_end_get_prim_type_len
summary: Looks up expected GPU primitive payload word length from command opcode byte.

name: kf_end_cpu_draw_otag
summary: Debug fallback traversing ordering table linked list and submitting each primitive via DrawPrim.

name: kf_end_dump_otag
summary: Walks ordering table linked list and logs primitive addresses, types, and errors.

name: kf_end_check_prim_valid
summary: Validates GPU primitive packet length matches opcode byte; logs diagnostic on mismatch.

name: kf_end_set_geom_offset
summary: Writes 16.16 fixed-point screen center projection offsets into GTE OFX and OFY registers.

name: kf_end_set_geom_screen
summary: Writes projection plane distance H into GTE H register.

name: kf_end_init_geom
summary: Enables COP2 in CPU Status register and initializes default GTE projection and fog constants.

name: kf_end_cd_init
summary: Retries CD-ROM hardware reset up to 5 times and installs default BIOS event delivery callbacks.

name: kf_end_cd_init_and_patch
summary: Patches PlayStation BIOS CD tables, resets CD-ROM drive, and hooks default sync/ready/data callbacks.

name: kf_end_cd_default_sync_event_cb
summary: Default CdSyncCallback delivering PS1 BIOS event 0xf0000003 class 0x20.

name: kf_end_cd_default_ready_event_cb
summary: Default CdReadyCallback delivering PS1 BIOS event 0xf0000003 class 0x40.

name: kf_end_cd_default_data_event_cb
summary: Default CdDataCallback delivering PS1 BIOS event 0xf0000003 class 0x40.

name: kf_end_cd_reset_wrapper
summary: Top-level CdReset wrapper forwarding reset mode into cd_hw_init.

name: kf_end_cd_sync
summary: Waits or polls CD command completion status and copies 8-byte CD response buffer.

name: kf_end_cd_ready
summary: Waits or polls CD sector data-ready interrupt status and copies 8-byte response buffer.

name: kf_end_cd_data_sync
summary: Waits or polls remaining CD DMA sector transfer count until zero or timeout.

name: kf_end_cd_sync_callback
summary: Installs user CdSyncCallback function pointer and returns previous handler.

name: kf_end_cd_ready_callback
summary: Installs user CdReadyCallback function pointer and returns previous handler.

name: kf_end_cd_data_callback
summary: Installs user CdDataCallback function pointer and returns previous handler.

name: kf_end_cd_control_exec
summary: Retries issuing CD-ROM command with temporary callback suspension until ack or retry exhaustion.

name: kf_end_cd_control
summary: Sends blocking/ack-waited CD-ROM control command and returns non-zero on success.

name: kf_end_cd_control_f
summary: Issues non-blocking fast CD-ROM control command without waiting for completion ack.

name: kf_end_cd_control_b
summary: Issues CD-ROM control command and blocks in CdSync(0) until CdlComplete.

name: kf_end_cd_read
summary: Configures CD sector mode/stride (0x800/0x924/0x918 bytes) and starts sector DMA read loop.

name: kf_end_cd_flush
summary: Flushes pending CD-ROM command state via CdlInit/reset FIFO command.

name: kf_end_cd_read2
summary: Sets CD-ROM mode, hooks streaming ring callbacks when stream bit 0x100 set, and starts CdlReadS.

name: kf_end_cd_int_to_pos
summary: Converts linear sector LBA index (+150 pregap) to BCD minute/second/sector CdlLOC struct.

name: kf_end_cd_memcpy8
summary: Copies 8-byte CD-ROM status response payload when destination pointer is non-null.

name: kf_end_cd_reset_timeout
summary: Sets CD-ROM watchdog deadline to current VSync counter plus 480 frames.

name: kf_end_cd_check_timeout
summary: Checks CD-ROM watchdog deadline and prints Sync/Ready diagnostics on timeout.

name: kf_end_cd_poll_irq_in_loop
summary: Polls CD interrupt status when CheckCallback reports software callback mode active.

name: kf_end_cd_intr_dispatch
summary: Drains pending CDROM interrupts and invokes registered CdReadyCallback and CdSyncCallback.

name: kf_end_cd_intr_handler
summary: Reads CDROM REG3/FIFO response bytes, classifies INT1..INT5 status, and updates sync/ready states.

name: kf_end_cd_wait_sync
summary: Waits for CdlComplete/CdlDiskError or returns 0 immediately in non-blocking mode.

name: kf_end_cd_wait_ready
summary: Waits for CD data-ready status or clears and returns immediately in non-blocking mode.

name: kf_end_cd_send_hw_cmd
summary: Writes command parameters to CDROM FIFO, triggers controller opcode, and optionally awaits INT2.

name: kf_end_cd_reset_fifo_and_mute
summary: Waits for CD sync idle and sends CD-ROM hardware register 3 control flags 0x20.

name: kf_end_cd_hw_init
summary: Initializes CD-ROM IRQ/SPU CD volume registers, resets drive, and configures CdlNop/Setmode.

name: kf_end_cd_start_sector_dma
summary: Arms CdReadyCallback chain and launches first CD sector DMA read.

name: kf_end_cd_data_sync_wait
summary: Spins until remaining sector count drains or disk error/timeout occurs.

name: kf_end_cd_sector_ready_cb
summary: CdReady ISR callback triggering sequential sector DMA reads and final CdDataCallback.

name: kf_end_cd_dma_read_sector
summary: Programs CDROM_DELAY and DMA Channel 3 to transfer one sector from CD FIFO into RAM.

name: kf_end_st_set_ring
summary: Binds STR streaming ring buffer base address and sector count, clearing all slot headers.

name: kf_end_st_clear_ring
summary: Resets active STR ring read/write indices and zeroes all ring sector status entries.

name: kf_end_st_unset_ring
summary: Detaches CD DMA and Ready streaming callbacks inside a critical section.

name: kf_end_st_dma_complete_cb
summary: CD DMA completion callback finalizing completed STR ring slots and invoking user decode notify.

name: kf_end_st_set_stream
summary: Configures live CD STR stream filtering, frame bounds, and ring completion callbacks.

name: kf_end_st_set_emulate
summary: Configures RAM-emulated STR stream playback source and completion callbacks.

name: kf_end_st_free_ring
summary: Marks all CD ring slots occupied by a decoded STR frame as free for overwrite.

name: kf_end_st_reset_ring_slots
summary: Clears status headers for consecutive STR ring slots.

name: kf_end_st_get_next
summary: Returns pointer and metadata header for next completely assembled STR frame in CD ring.

name: kf_end_st_set_mask
summary: Sets STR stream frame mask flag and frame range limits.

name: kf_end_st_ring_sector_intr
summary: CD Ready interrupt handler validating 0x0160 STR chunks and DMA-assembling multi-sector frames.

name: kf_end_dma_start_channel
summary: Low-level PS1 DMA channel launcher checking channel busy status and arming DPCR/DICR.

name: kf_end_cd_copy_dwords
summary: Copies 32-bit words between buffers for RAM-emulated STR ring reads.

name: kf_end_enter_critical_section
summary: Invokes PS1 BIOS EnterCriticalSection syscall(0) wrapper to mask interrupts.

name: kf_end_cd_install_bios_hooks
summary: Patches BIOS A(0) function vectors at 0xa00003e0..0x48c with libcd helper wrappers.

name: kf_end_cd_bios_seek_l
summary: BIOS CD hook issuing blocking CdlSeekL (0x15) command.

name: kf_end_cd_bios_pause
summary: BIOS CD hook issuing blocking CdlPause (0x08) command.

name: kf_end_cd_bios_nop
summary: BIOS CD hook issuing blocking CdlNop (0x01) status query.

name: kf_end_cd_bios_read_sync
summary: BIOS CD hook initiating single-sector read and polling CdDataSync until idle.

name: kf_end_cd_bios_call_a0
summary: Dispatches PlayStation BIOS A(0) table syscall vector.

name: kf_end_cd_search_file
summary: Resolves ISO9660 backslash path on disc and populates CdlFILE location and byte size.

name: kf_end_cd_cmp_filename12
summary: Compares 12-character uppercase 8.3 ISO9660 directory entry filenames.

name: kf_end_cd_new_media
summary: Reads ISO9660 Primary Volume Descriptor, verifies CD001 signature, and caches path table.

name: kf_end_cd_find_dir_in_path_table
summary: Scans cached ISO9660 path table entries matching parent directory ID and directory name.

name: kf_end_cd_cache_dir_files
summary: Reads ISO9660 directory extent sector and caches filenames, BCD locations, and byte sizes.

name: kf_end_cd_memcpy_bytes
summary: Local byte-copy helper compiled inside libcd ISO9660 filesystem unit.

name: kf_end_cd_read_sectors_sync
summary: Seeks to LBA sector via CdlSetloc and synchronously reads ISO9660 metadata sectors.

name: kf_end_set_dma_mdec_in_callback
summary: Registers DMA Channel 0 (MDEC input) completion callback via DMACallback.

name: kf_end_set_dma_mdec_out_callback
summary: Registers DMA Channel 1 (MDEC output) completion callback via DMACallback.

name: kf_end_set_dma_cdrom_callback
summary: Registers DMA Channel 3 (CD-ROM) completion callback via DMACallback.

name: kf_end_set_dma_spu_callback
summary: Registers DMA Channel 4 (SPU) completion callback via DMACallback.

name: kf_end_set_dma_pio_callback
summary: Registers DMA Channel 5 (PIO) completion callback via DMACallback.

name: kf_end_set_gpu_irq_callback
summary: Registers GPU IRQ slot 2 interrupt handler via InterruptCallback.

name: kf_end_set_spu_irq_callback
summary: Registers SPU IRQ slot 9 interrupt handler via InterruptCallback.

name: kf_end_set_sio_irq_callback
summary: Registers SIO/Controller IRQ slot 10 interrupt handler via InterruptCallback.

name: kf_end_start_vsync_irq
summary: Configures HBlank timer, enables VSync IRQ 0 handler, and returns VSyncCallback setter pointer.

name: kf_end_stop_vsync_irq
summary: Detaches VSync IRQ 0 handler and clears active VSync callback state.

name: kf_end_invoke_vsync_callback
summary: Invokes registered user VSync interrupt callback function pointer if non-null.

name: kf_end_vsync_callback_impl
summary: Stores new VSync user callback pointer (starting VSync IRQ if needed) and returns previous pointer.

name: kf_end_pad_init
summary: Resets callback subsystem and initializes BIOS controller pad polling via PAD_init2.

name: kf_end_pad_read
summary: Polls PlayStation BIOS PAD_dr and returns inverted bitmask of pressed controller buttons.

name: kf_end_pad_stop
summary: Stops PlayStation controller BIOS driver polling via StopPAD2.

name: kf_end_reset_callback
summary: Initializes libetc IRQ/DMA callback tables via internal ResetCallback handler.

name: kf_end_interrupt_callback
summary: Dispatches InterruptCallback registration into active callback dispatcher.

name: kf_end_dma_callback
summary: Invokes active DMA callback registration vector from callback vtable.

name: kf_end_vsync_callback_entry
summary: Entry prelude jumping through VSync callback vtable vector for kf_end_vsync_callback.

name: kf_end_vsync_callback
summary: Invokes active VSync callback registration vector from callback vtable slot +0x14.

name: kf_end_stop_callback
summary: Invokes active StopCallback vector from callback vtable slot +0x10 to shut down IRQs.

name: kf_end_check_callback
summary: Returns active software interrupt callback state flag from libetc dispatcher.

name: kf_end_init_irq_dispatcher
summary: Installs BIOS HookEntryInt interrupt dispatcher, initializes VSync/DMA chains, and clears I_MASK.

name: kf_end_register_irq_handler
summary: Binds or clears hardware interrupt callback handler for IRQ 0..10 and updates I_MASK.

name: kf_end_teardown_irq_dispatcher

name: kf_end_init_dma_dispatcher

name: kf_end_stop_dma_dispatcher
summary: Detaches IRQ 3 DMA master handler and clears DMA channel callbacks.

name: kf_end_dma_irq_dispatch
summary: Services DICR DMA channel completion flags and invokes per-channel callbacks.

name: kf_end_vsync
summary: Waits for N VSync frames or returns HBlank counter / elapsed VSync tick depending on mode.

name: kf_end_vsync_wait_target

name: kf_end_ss_init_internal

name: kf_end_ss_init

name: kf_end_ss_init_hot

name: kf_end_ss_set_table_size

name: kf_end_ss_timer_delay_spin

name: kf_end_ss_start_tick_timer

name: kf_end_ss_start2

name: kf_end_ss_start
summary: Starts libsnd audio processing engine using configured tick mode.

name: kf_end_ss_end

name: kf_end_ss_start_rcnt

name: kf_end_ss_stop_rcnt

name: kf_end_ss_set_serial_vol

name: kf_end_ss_alloc_spu_voice

name: kf_end_ss_voice_calc_seq_vol_pan_head
